animals.Name: Demo
animals.Description:
Demo comes to us from our Alabama partner, where he was found as a stray and then grew up in a shelter. He had minimal human interaction and because of this, Demo needs a patient owner who will let him warm up on his own terms. Demo will do best in a home with another confident dog to learn from and be best buddies with; and a home that has a fenced in yard. Demo is incredibly sweet and kind once he gets to know his humans and will mimic the dog of the house.  You will be able to pet him and give him hugs and he will tell you stories at bedtime reminding you to it’s time to go to bed.  He’s quite the character.

Demo’s foster got him DNA tested using Embark and the results were 32.3% Great Pyrenees, 28.8% American Pit Bull Terrier, 22.3% Supermutt™ (Komondor, Weimaraner, Staffordshire Terrier, Boxer), and 16.6% Anatolian Shepherd.  

Energy Level: Demo is a low- to medium-energy pup who loves to play with all the dogs in his foster home for an hour or two at night (or longer if there’s a high-energy player in the house). He will play whenever another dog wants to, but he is very respectful if they don’t. He is happy to go on a daily walk if you’d like, but he can also take a day off from walking. 

Training: Demo has mostly been learning how to live in a house while in Wisconsin and that his foster mom and visitors are safe. Demo is a major creature of habit. He runs to his kennel for meals. 

Demo also loves scent work and he's really good at it! Livestock guardian dogs have excellent noses! We are only working with one scent right now, vanilla. This is a great training game for him to gain confidence in working with his humans! 

Crate Training: Demo is very food motivated and goes into his kennel easily because he knows he gets meals and treats there. He easily crates all day long next to the resident dog and fellow foster dogs.
Potty Training: Demo is fully potty trained. 

Grooming: Demo has hair similar to a Lab and will need regular brushing due to shedding. 

Dogs: Demo loves every dog in his home. He also goes to doggy daycare and is making new friends there. When he sees another dog across the street while on a walk, he completely ignores them. He also loves every foster that’s come through our house and all the alumni that have come back to stay for a weekend while their parents are out of town.  He’s truly a dog’s dog.

Cats: Demo lives with two cats. They mostly stay upstairs, but when he is around them he gets a bit excited and wants to be best friends. He doesn’t understand that when they run away, they are trying to get away from him.  Demo is an avid sniffer, so cats that don’t like being sniffed by a dog are not a good match for him. 

Demo sleeps upstairs in the bedroom that the cats are in at night with the resident dog and his foster mom to help him bond. He’s doing excellent at learning good behaviors with the cats. He can still get a little nosy though because he loves everyone. 
When we don’t have other fosters the cats are allowed to free roam and Demo is learning to let them be.  Both cats trust him and come out of hiding.

Kids: Demo gets nervous around kids that are the same height as him and will drool, cower and shy away. He has not met teens in my presence. 

People: When Demo meets new people, he follows the resident dog and mirrors their behavior. He is gaining confidence and learning a lot. 

Demo will lie on the couch to hang out with his foster mom and sometimes even snuggles. He loves being on the bed and now allows you to snuggle with him and he’ll even put his face against yours to snuggle in. He’s gaining so much confidence and trust! 

Overall, Demo is an incredibly sweet and goofy boy. He wants everyone to like him but is a little shy at first. Once you are fully accepted into his pack, Demo will sit on you—or another dog. He would do best in a home with another confident dog to learn from, and even better if that dog enjoys playing!

animals.Name: Buddy
animals.Description:
Buddy is a senior cocker spaniel who was surrendered to Fetch when his elderly owner developed health issues and had to go into long term care. He is a happy guy with a big heart and a touch of doggy dementia.

Buddy absolutely loves other dogs and is tolerant of all ages, including puppies. He loves his people very much and is always up for attention and snuggles. He is not so good with strangers and will bark loudly when he sees someone he doesn’t know. Sometimes he forgets that he has already met someone and will bark loudly again. He is not a bite risk as he only has a few teeth left (more on that later) but I typically put him in his crate when new people come over so he doesn’t get worked up.

Buddy has some health issues typical of senior dogs. He has a heart murmur that does not currently cause any symptoms and some arthritis that does not keep him from loving his walks and pulling hard on his leash. He has been diagnosed with chronic stenosis of the ear canals so will need to be monitored for ear infections. He also has KCS which is common in smaller breeds and means his eyes do not produce enough tears. He gets eye drops twice a day to stimulate tear production and his eyes look perfect now, but he will need to stay on the eye drops for the rest of his life. He had most of his teeth removed due to severe dental disease, but he still prefers hard kibble to softened food. He can’t chew but he just swallows it whole.

Buddy is very well behaved in his crate and will go in there on his own during the day to nap. He typically is crated for about 6 hours during the workday and about 10 hours at night and does great on that schedule. He is fully potty trained. He is low shedding and needs a haircut about every 4-5 months which he does very well with.

If you have a spot in your home for a fuzzy old man who will bark loudly at you for about 10 minutes and then love you forever, come meet Buddy!

animals.Name: Duke
animals.Description:
Meet Duke, a handsome adolescent cattle dog mix with a big personality and the most perfect ears. Duke loves everyone he’s met. He welcomes guests into our house and immediately asks for pets. He also currently lives with two dogs and loves to play with the younger one.

Smart and extremely food-motivated, Duke is easy and fun to train. He apparently thinks kibble is the greatest thing that exists in this world. He has some classic cattle dog traits and adolescent behaviors, so he won’t be the right fit for every home, but for the right family or active individual, he’s an amazing companion.

A day in Duke’s life:

Morning: 45-minute walk to start the day

Playtime with resident dog, then breakfast

Crated during the workday

Evening: yard play, then free in the house with occasional playtime

Dinner

Night: a chew and cozy hanging-out time

Duke’s ideal home is active and consistent, and can provide daily exercise, mental stimulation, and continued training. Duke needs a home that’s more experienced with dogs of his breed mix and age, who can continue to guide him toward becoming a thoughtful adult who makes his own good choices. He can get overexcited when seeing dogs, but would love to live with compatible dogs after a proper introduction and if the dogs are consistently separated for food, as he can guard meals and chews. If you’re looking for a loyal, smart, and affectionate buddy and are ready for a lively young cattle-dog mix, Duke could be your perfect match.

Attributes.AttributeName: ✅ Can free roam when humans are gone

animals.Name: Diamond
animals.Description:
Meet Princess Diamond: A Snuggly, Dazzling Girl Looking for Her Forever Home!

Diamond is one of the most affectionate dogs you’ll be lucky to meet. Though she needs patient introductions to new humans, she adores every human her foster family has brought into her circle! Diamond is a cuddly girl, and loves to lay on top of you or by your feet. Your heart will melt when she rests her chin on your chest.  She will bond deeply with whoever is lucky enough to adopt her.

Rescued in Arkansas, Diamond spent several months with a local rescue before making her way to the Midwest. She’s adapted exceptionally well to Wisconsin living!

Diamond is polite and relaxed inside her home. She rarely barks, never chews on items she shouldn’t, and loves to laze around in her favorite cozy spots! She has never shown any kind of resource guarding with humans, and is gentle when taking treats. She loves toys and will happily play fetch or tug with her humans.

Diamond is fully potty-trained and crate-trained. She’s never had an accident inside the house. Diamond is a smart girl and will go into her crate on command! She will happily snooze in her crate for up to 4 hours at a time. Diamond can also be left to free-roam.

Diamond walks well on leash, and prefers leisurely strolls with lots of sniffing and joyful rolling in the grass. She’s a curious girl, and will occasionally lunge at a squirrel or bird. Diamond is working through leash reactivity towards other pups, but can be redirected with treats.

Because of her past behavior towards other dogs, Diamond must be the only pet in her home. This is ideal so she can give you all her love and attention!

Diamond would do well in an adult-only home or in a home with older, quieter kids.

Diamond is looking for a loving adopter who is willing to take things slowly as she adjusts to her new home. If you're the kind of person who appreciates a sweet, affectionate dog with a big heart, Diamond is the dog for you.

Attributes.AttributeName: ✅ Can free roam when humans are gone

animals.Name: Max
animals.Description:
Max is a beautiful 2 year old Siberian husky who was surrendered due to his owner’s family health issues. He is a happy, friendly guy who is potty trained, crate trained and knows basic commands (although whether he chooses to listen or is distracted by his husky brain is another story lol - but if you have food, he will ALWAYS listen!). He gets along great with other dogs but gets a little too excited about cats and wants to chase them. Max is very chill for a husky and spends most of the day sleeping, although he does enjoy going out in the yard and exploring the fence line. He loves to get pets and rub up against you. If he wants attention he will talk to you as huskies do until you notice him.

Max has idiopathic epilepsy and takes seizure medications twice a day. He is in the process of switching to a new medication that should better control his type of seizures. His goal is to have a seizure no more than once every few months, but he will likely never be completely seizure free. His adopters will need to be aware and comfortable with that. His meds make him drink a lot of water, so he has to pee a lot. He would do best with someone who is home most of the time and able to let him out.

If you are looking for a dog who is past the puppy stage but still young enough to be your buddy for many years, Max is your guy!

animals.Name: Archer James
animals.Description:
Hi! My name is Archer, Archie for short, A.J. for being cool, and Archer James for long. I’m a very loyal guy. I love my people and look for praise and reinforcement as much as possible. I like sniffing... with my nose.... really close....to the point that my nose makes contact with the item to sniff it extra good! I am getting used to a lot of things and noises, so sometimes I jump a little, but once I hear it and you remind me it’s okay, then I’m good. Just some other things I want to share about myself, I like cuddling, napping, going on walks, and getting the zoomies in the backyard. Okay, now my foster humans can talk….

Archer is a very sweet boy who is working on his confidence. Once a Ridglan beagle, he’s still learning how to be a dog, which will be a lifelong battle for him. He needs someone who is patient and understanding, and willing to go at his pace. He looks up at you for reassurance and does great with positive reinforcement.
Potty training is mostly good as long as he has a routine, and he’s still figuring out that grass is the place to go, so a little patience and praise for going in the right spot will help. He’s learning leash manners quickly and loves his walks.

Archer does well in his kennel! He sometimes he wanders in on his own for a nap when the door is open.
A few fun facts: Archer loves ceiling fans, naps under a blanket, and rolling in the grass. He does NOT love bagpipes or loud cars.

animals.Name: Stacy
animals.Description:
Stacy: Your Dog’s Very Own Cat-Dog Hybrid (Now in a shorter, sillier edition)
Looking for a cat for your dog? Perfect. Stacy has arrived to fill that extremely niche job.

Sweet, tiny Stacy is basically a travel‑sized Great Pyrenees with the soul of a mildly judgmental house cat. She and her brother Demo started life on the streets of Alabama, then somehow ended up in Wisconsin, where she now supervises humans with quiet disapproval.

She’s gentle, quirky, shy at first, and absolutely convinced she is cooler than everyone. Stacy loves affection—after she decides you deserve it. She does not follow you everywhere, for she has important cat‑dog business to attend to. While gentle with children, she can be startled by loud noises or sudden movements, so she’ll be happiest in a quieter home.

Her favorite things:
* Her dog friends (non‑negotiable—she needs at least one).
* Butt wiggles that appear without warning.
* Randomly showing up with a stick in her mouth, peeking around the corner like she’s checking if you’re busy.
* Making ridiculous faces that seem designed to make you laugh.
* Acting like a cat who accidentally downloaded the “dog” expansion pack.

She’s house trained, walks beautifully on leash, and can free‑roam like a tiny, furry landlord. Quiet, polite, expressive, and occasionally smirky—Stacy is 72% dog, 28% cat, and 100% cute weirdo.

Stacy is looking for:
* A patient human who understands shy dogs.
* A calm home where she can bloom.
* A friendly dog buddy to be her emotional-support extrovert.
* Someone who appreciates cat energy in a dog body.
If you’ve ever said, “I want a cat… but also a dog,” congratulations. Stacy is your girl.

Attributes.AttributeName: ✅ Can free roam when humans are gone
⚠ Needs another dog in the home

animals.Name: Turtle
animals.Description:
Turtle’s story began in a rural Alabama shelter, where he and his nine siblings were rescued together. One by one, each pup found a home… except Turtle. While his brothers and sisters have all been adopted, Turtle is still patiently waiting for the family who will finally see him.

Turtle is a joyful, toy‑loving sweetheart with a wonderful foundation of training. He is crate trained, house trained, walks nicely on a leash in familiar places, rides beautifully in the car, and has yet to meet a toy he doesn’t love. He’s currently thriving in a multi‑dog foster home, where he enjoys companionship, playtime, and the comfort of having another dog nearby.

Because Turtle was briefly adopted as an only dog and did not thrive, he must have a canine companion in his forever home. He gains confidence from other dogs and feels most secure with a buddy by his side. He’s not just dog‑friendly - he’s a dog who needs another dog to be his best self.

If you’ve been considering adopting two dogs together, Turtle and Kyle (https://fetchwi.org/dog#kyle) are currently sharing the same foster home and would make a fantastic duo. They aren’t a bonded pair, but they coexist beautifully, complement each other’s personalities, and would transition smoothly into a forever home together.

Turtle has waited so long that he’s ready for a family who understands his gentle heart, his need for a dog companion, and his desire to finally be someone’s forever.

Attributes.AttributeName: ⚠ Needs another dog in the home

animals.Name: Ciabatta
animals.Description:
Ciabatta is a playful, cuddle-puddle of a pup just looking for a forever family to help her feel safe and enjoy new adventures! She can be slow to warm up to humans and some dogs, but once they have proven themselves "safe," you'll never find a better playmate, couch-snuggler or treat-motivated trainee. When with a trusted human (currently me), she is quite brave and open to new experiences. She loves to wrassle and play with humans, toys and sticks and does well playing by herself. She still gets a bit mouthy when playing, but is very gentle about it. However, because of this and her cautiousness around unexpected movements, we suspect she would do better with only older or dog-savvy children. She loves having her neck and ears scratched, and spoons tightly against our legs if allowed in bed. She has done well in her crate for extended periods, but because she also does well free-roaming, we have mostly been letting her free-roam during the day and overnight. She has done fine being alone for 8-10 hours.
She has mostly been afraid of our cat, but her response has been intermittently barking/reactive, so we did not list her as cat-friendly. I think she could be trained to get along with a cat with a bit of consistency.
She had a hip surgery on 10/16/26 due to an old, poorly-healed fracture, and is recovering nicely, but currently limited in her activity levels. Prior to surgery, she loved racing around the yard, longer walks and hiking, even though it wore her out. It is expected that that when fully recovered, she will be able to hike, run and play with no limitations.
She is fully potty-trained, but prefers to go off-leash in our backyard and has not "done her business" on walks.

animals.Name: McQueen
animals.Description: Hi! I’m McQueen. I’m a playful puppy who loves adventure. I love going for walks, chewing on bones, riding in the car, and playing with my toys. A lot of people I meet call me cute and say I have the most beautiful eyes. I’m a bit shy when meeting other dogs and people, but I will come around and remember you next time I see you! I am crate trained at night and when being left for longer periods during the day. I’m working hard on potty training. I still need time and access to consistent potty breaks. I make my foster family laugh every day with my adorable personality and I’m ready to find my forever home!

animals.Name: Cyndi
animals.Description:
Hi, I'm Cyndi and I'm ready to steal your heart!

I'm a typical puppy full of energy and curiosity, and I absolutely love to play and I'm learning to snuggle with my people. I've met dogs, cats, and kids in my foster home, so with continued socialization, I'll fit right into just about any family! I promise to bring double the fun and twice the love to your home.

I am currently living in a litter foster home, which means you can meet me and all my available siblings and choose your best fit!

animals.Name: Frenchi
animals.Description: Frenchi is a fun-loving little girl who loves to play with her pack.  She is learning potty training and is getting used to her kennel.  She settles into it after a bit of mouthiness, but will then sleep through the night.

animals.Name: Seymour
animals.Description:
Meet Seymour, a 70-pound cuddle bug with the heart of a teddy bear. At six years old, Seymour has mastered the art of companionship; whether he’s following his foster family from room to room or curled up in a cozy corner, he just wants to be where his people are. If you’re looking for a loyal sidekick who believes in the power of snuggles and endless kisses, Seymour is your guy.

At six years old, Seymour is fairly mellow but does have a playful side. He loves to chase a ball around or play with the resident dog in his foster home. Seymour also loves his walks, and his foster family is helping him practice polite leash manners.

Seymour comes with a great foundation of training. He is fully potty trained, crate trained (but would also be fine free roaming when home alone), and already knows how to sit and shake.  A smart guy with an eagerness to please, Seymour should be a quick study with any new tricks you want to teach him. 

Seymour is ready to find a forever home where he can shower his new family with love. He can't wait to meet you and hopefully become your new best friend ❤️

Attributes.AttributeName: ✅ Can free roam when humans are gone

animals.Name: Simba
animals.Description:
Simba is a gentle, quirky good boy who loves people, cuddles, naps, squeaky toys, and car rides. He enjoys two walks a day with plenty of time to sniff and explore. He knows his basic commands and can free-roam in the home. He gets along great with cats and dogs but prefers calmer canine friends who won’t jump on his back. Loud noises can scare him, so he’d thrive in a quieter home. He occasionally barks but eventually settles down.

Simba has perianal fistulas managed with medication, so his future family will need to keep up with his medical care. With patience and a loving home, this sweet boy will make a wonderful companion!

animals.Name: Bengie
animals.Description:
Bengie is a sweet and shy guy who came to Fetch from an over crowded shelter in Texas. The shelter environment was very scary for him, and he was a bit shut down there. Since arriving at his foster home, he has really had the chance to blossom and show his sweet and silly personality! Bengie loves to play with toys, get zoomies in the yard with his foster dog siblings, and curl up on the couch. He loves other dogs and follows his foster mom and dad all around the house. He is potty trained and does great out of his crate in a bedroom over night and while his foster parents are at work. He loves to keep busy with toys and likes to chew on chew toys. He is working on learning not to chew on wood furniture and is easily redirected with a chew toy and learning boundaries quickly. 

Bengie is still learning to trust humans and will need someone patient and willing to take the time to allow him decompress and earn his trust. He is such a cute and sweet guy, his foster mom thinks he is totally worth the wait! 

He would likely do best in a home without young children. He is still learning how to walk on a leash and will need a home with a fenced yard or an enclosure while he gets used to leash walks.

animals.Name: Callum
animals.Description:
🐾 Meet Callum! 🐾

Callum is all smiles, snuggles, and puppy playfulness! 💙 This happy little guy loves to play with his favorite toys, romp around with other dogs, and soak up all the cuddles he can get. His favorite playmate is his sister, Cherokee, and he especially enjoys having another pup around to share in the fun!

When he’s not busy playing, Callum is more than happy to snuggle up with his people and show off his sweet, smiley personality. He’s the perfect mix of playful energy and cuddly puppy love!

Callum is ready to find his forever family to share all his love, puppy kisses, and happy little smiles with! 🐶❤️

animals.Name: Peanut
animals.Description: Do you need an extra shadow in your life who simply wants treats and snuggles for unconditional love? Meet Peanut! The most gentle and sweetest dog you will ever meet. She is content with just a few short walks throughout the day and then will pull you back home for her beauty rest. Peanut loves people but is a shy girl around other animals. Extremely food motivated and a fast learner! This easy to care for, disciplined girl does great on leash and is potty trained and crate trained. A calm home with plenty of napping spots will be a dream come true for this little peanut.

Attributes.AttributeName: ✅ Can free roam when humans are gone
Wouldn't mind being an only dog

animals.Name: Bubby
animals.Description:
Bubby is the sweetest old man who loves to be super cozy!

Bubby walks well on leash, but due to arthritis (which he takes medication & supplements for), he isn’t up for long walks or strenuous activities. He enjoys sniff walks, but he spends most of his day snoozing. He loves playing in water (which is great for his weekly dermatitis baths) and with squeaky toys!

Bubz is potty trained and able to free roam during the work day with my dog. He would do well with another calm dog or by himself. Cats are unknown, and living with small children would be overwhelming for him.

Bubby’s body shows signs that he has not always been well taken care of, so he is looking for a retirement home where he can be spoiled, sleep in your bed, and eat lots of snacks (he prefers beef)! Despite his age & past, his bloodwork looks great, and he has a wonderful quality of life!

Attributes.AttributeName: ✅ Can free roam when humans are gone

animals.Name: Reno
animals.Description:
Meet Reno! This handsome Australian Kelpie mix is the ultimate blend of fun, brains, and youthful enthusiasm. If you’re looking for an active, well-mannered adventure buddy who will happily keep pace with your lifestyle, Reno is ready to steal your heart.

Personality & Social Skills
Reno is a total social butterfly when it comes to other dogs—he currently lives with a canine housemate and absolutely thrives on having furry friends to play with. He's also a superstar in public. He walks nicely on a leash, likes going for car rides, and is a world-class play partner who loves fetch and toys.

Training & Daily Routine
Reno is wonderfully house-trained, sleeps quietly through the night in his crate, and handles a typical workday home alone in his crate like a pro (no chewing or howling here!). He responds well to corrections like "no" or "down" and is generally very easy to handle.

That said, we promise to keep it real! Reno has a few typical teenager quirks:

The Thrill of the Chase: While he's usually a gentleman on walks, he will get excited and tug on the leash if a squirrel, bunny, or passing dog catches his eye.
Counter-Surfing: He has a habit of putting his paws up on the counter (though he's a good boy and hasn't actually stolen anything yet).
Furry Footwear Warning: Fuzzy shoes look suspiciously like dog toys to him, so you'll want to keep your slippers safely tucked away!

Energy Level & Ideal Home
Reno is sitting right in that sweet spot of medium-to-high energy. He will do best in a home that can commit to a couple of solid daily walks (30 to 60+ minutes total) alongside some good old-fashioned playtime or a chance to burn off steam with another dog.

If you have an active lifestyle and a soft spot for smart herding breeds that are loyal and love attention, Reno might just be your perfect match. Are you ready to welcome this sweet, playful guy into your family?

animals.Name: Athena
animals.Description:
Athena is discovering what it means to just be a dog. After spending her early life in survival mode and raising her puppies, she's finally getting the chance to focus on herself. While the world still feels a little overwhelming to her, Athena is a gentle, sweet soul who desperately wants to trust and connect with people.

Athena is timid and carefully approaches new situations at her own pace, so she'll thrive with a patient adopter who understands that trust takes time. She may not be an instant best friend, but for someone willing to celebrate the small victories, watching Athena come out of her shell will be incredibly rewarding. Beneath her shy exterior is a wonderful companion just waiting to blossom.

She walks nicely on leash but can be startled by busy surroundings, so she'd be happiest in a quieter home. Athena gains confidence from other dogs and often looks to them for reassurance, so she will need a friendly canine companion in her adoptive home.

Athena is dog-friendly, likely cat-friendly, crate trained, and often chooses the comfort of her crate when she needs a safe place to relax.

If you're the kind of person who understands that the best relationships are worth waiting for, Athena would love the chance to show you just how special she is. ❤️

Attributes.AttributeName: ⚠ Needs another dog in the home

animals.Name: Lucky
animals.Description: Lucky has been so easy for us as foster parents! She’s house trained and is fine left at home for 8 hours if that’s your workday. She is great on walks! When we pass other dogs or people she's interested in you in a very friendly way. She rarely ever barks. Usually if she sees another dog going by through the window, she'll watch it walk by and maybe whimper a little.

animals.Name: Cain
animals.Description:
Meet Cain, a striking black-and-white mixed breed with a heart as big as his smile! At just 8 months old and 41 pounds, this handsome parvo survivor has already overcome a tough start and is ready to find the loving family he's been waiting for.

Cain is an affectionate, playful pup who loves spending time with his people. He can be a little shy when meeting new people, so he does best with slow, respectful introductions while he gets comfortable. Once he warms up, he’s happy to be part of the action: whether he’s exploring on a walk, chasing a tennis ball in the backyard, or sneaking in a kiss. He also gets along well with other active dogs.

He's house trained, walks nicely on leash, and is a dream in his crate, sleeping quietly through the night without a fuss. Cain is eager to learn and enjoys practicing new skills. He's currently working on sit, down, and touch, and would love a family that will continue building his confidence and skills through training.

Like most teenage pups, Cain is still figuring out his manners. He can get a little mouthy or jump up when he's excited, but he's easily redirected and improves with consistency.

Cain's ideal home is one that enjoys staying active and will include him in daily walks, games of fetch, and plenty of quality time together. In return, you'll get a loyal companion with a goofy personality, a loving heart, and a lifetime of adventures ahead. 🐶 🐮

animals.Name: Zombie
animals.Description: After a rough start, Zombie is really coming along wonderfully.  He is a low energy gentle giant and really just loves to hang out with his people.

Attributes.AttributeName: Wouldn't mind being an only dog

animals.Name: Monona
animals.Description:
Hello, I'm Monona, a red and white tick-patterned beauty with likely coonhound and cattle dog heritage running through my veins! 

I'm a typical puppy who loves to play and snuggle, and I've already proven I'm friendly with cats, dogs, and kids alike. Whether it's playtime or cuddle time, I'm your girl; I thrive on both! 

I am currently living in a litter foster home, which means you can meet me and all my available siblings and choose your best fit!

animals.Name: Berry
animals.Description:
Berry is a sweet, loving dog! She loves to snuggle and reach out to put a gentle paw on you. She isn’t super interested in her toys, aside from the more interactive ones, but is happy to entertain herself. She is a pretty laid-back dog and happy to match our energy levels! She is also a quiet girl and has yet to bark, whine, or beg. She will cuddle and receive pets anytime, anywhere from people she’s familiar with.

Berry is a bit of a shy dog around new people and can be a bit skittish on walks, but she is getting braver and braver every day! I’m not sure the downtown city life is the best for Berry, it seems she could thrive with a fenced in backyard and/or a quiet neighborhood.

Her foster in Alabama said she was great with other dogs and would thrive with a companion dog!

Attributes.AttributeName: ✅ Can free roam when humans are gone

animals.Name: Cherokee
animals.Description:
🐾 Meet Cherokee! 🐾

Cherokee is a sweet, playful girl with a big personality and a smile that will melt your heart! 💕 She loves playing with her favorite toys, making new doggy friends, and spending time with her brother, Callum. Whether she’s chasing toys or wrestling around with her favorite playmate, Cherokee is always ready for a little adventure!

Once playtime is over, Cherokee is happy to slow down and enjoy some snuggles with her people. She has the perfect combination of playful puppy energy and a loving, cuddly side that makes her so special!

Cherokee is ready to find a family of her own to fill their days with puppy fun, sweet snuggles, and lots of love! 🐶❤️

animals.Name: Mary Beth
animals.Description:
Mary Beth is the kind of dog who makes friends everywhere she goes. This sweet girl is full of love and generous with her kisses, always happy to show her people just how much she cares. She is incredibly attentive to humans and loves being part of whatever you're doing, whether that's heading out for a walk or spending a quiet afternoon relaxing at home.
Mary Beth is dog-friendly and enjoys the company of other dogs. Her story began in Alabama, where she was found as a stray while pregnant. After lovingly raising her puppies—the "Plant Puppies" who are currently available for adoption—it's finally Mary Beth's turn to find a family of her own.
She loves walks, thrives on companionship, and is ready to be someone's loyal best friend. After giving so much love to her puppies, Mary Beth deserves a home where she can be cherished just as much. If you're looking for a sweet, affectionate companion who will happily share life's everyday moments with you, Mary Beth may be the perfect fit. ❤️

Attributes.AttributeName: ✅ Can free roam when humans are gone

animals.Name: Benny
animals.Description:
Benny is an Olde English Bulldog/Rottweiler/Australian Shepherd mix. He is the snuggliest boy! He loves to play fetch, trying new puzzles, and going on adventures!

Benny thrives with constant movement and mind games. He is good with other dogs, not sure about cats and I don't think he would be good with kids under 12- he just doesn't understand his size. he sleeps in the bed and gets taken out as soon as he wakes up, then fed, then taken out again in the backyard to run a little and play fetch. We are out of the house for 5-8 hours sometimes and he doesn't like the kennel and will break out of it. Then when we get home take him out, then feed him, take him out to run in the backyard. He gets let out many times before bed. Then we chill, then go to bed. He needs someone active and ready to train! Right now he is learning how to lay down and relax- he gets very excited! We are working on potty training, calming down and walking with a leash. He is very food motivated!

Overall, Benny is super sweet, snuggly, active and very very loyal.

animals.Name: Eevee
animals.Description:
Eevee is a sweet and spunky almost 7 yr old dachshund mix. She loves fetch, snuggling on the couch, and being around her person. She comes from the south so she’s still getting used to the cold weather and snow. She’s had multiple households with other dogs and plays well with others.

Eevee is looking for a new home because of her owner’s changing living situation and work schedule. She would do best living with a single person who is home most of the time.

animals.Name: Emma
animals.Description:
Meet Emma!

Emma is a sweet two-year-old black lab mix looking for her forever home. She's eager to please and adores attention from her people. Whether it's pets, praise, or a spot on your lap, she soaks it all up.

She's got plenty of energy and loves her walks, chasing squirrels, and running in a fenced yard. But when the day winds down, she's just as happy curled up in your lap for a cuddle. She's great with people of all ages and has never met a hand she didn't want to be petted by.

Emma walks well on a leash. She pulls a little but responds quickly to redirection. She isn't reactive toward people or dogs she passes. She knows her basic commands and is very food motivated, so she picks up new things fast.

Emma has been through a lot of changes recently, and living with a new dog has been stressful for her. She'll do best as the only pet in the home, especially while she settles in. With a steady routine and consistent training, she'll blossom.

She's spayed and up to date on her vaccines, with no medical conditions or special diet. She's a healthy, easy keeper.

If you're looking for a loving, loyal companion who's up for adventures and couch time alike, Emma might be your girl! ❤️
